title: SCP-1499, The Gas Mask
description: The mask hides you from this world… but brings you into another.
body:
The Gas Mask adds a new dimension. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-1499, also known as the The Gas Mask.


SCP-1499 is a gas mask that allows players to enter an alternate dimension. SCP-1499 can be found lying on the ground and picked up by right-clicking. When worn, SCP-1499 transports the player into a new, flat, dark dimension, filled with strange pillar-like structures. The dimension is also inhabited by hostile creatures known as SCP-1499-1, who display aggressive group behavior when attacked or approached too closely. Removing the mask returns the player safely to the overworld.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-1499 spawn?

SCP-1499  can spawn anywhere in the overworld like a normal monster. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-1499.

► How can I enter and exit the SCP-1499 Dimension?

To enter SCP-1499's dimension, right-click SCP-1499 in your hand. To escape the dimension you have to unwear SCP-1499, which will take you back to the spawn.

► Why is there no 1.19.2 version?

There isn't a 1.19.2 version of SCP-1499 because MCreator changed the way to make dimensions just like SCP-1499 Dimension in higher versions. Converting the mod to 1.19.2 will break the mod since the dimensions worked different in an older version of MCreator.

► Why is my SCP-1499 gone?

This can happen if you don't press shift while taking the mask off. The Mask will then be gone and you have to search for a new one.

► Why do the terrain look so buggy?

Due to the close generation, the terrain generate inside each other which makes them look so destroyed.

</details>



![SCP-1499](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4bcfd0f5f30618fc1af42c5c8d34933e3f9e20e0.png)

SCP-1499 spawns lying on the ground and can be collected by right-clicking it. As an item, it can be placed back when sneaking and right-clicking a block. When worn, SCP-1499 instantly teleports the player into its dimension A flat world with a dark sky and endless stone-like pillars. Removing the mask returns the player to the overworld. But removing the mask without pressing shift can lead to losing SCP-1499.
